instructions.name: Liquidity floor
instructions.content: Reject any token with less than 150 SOL of pool liquidity.

instructions.name: Holder concentration
instructions.content: Treat a top-10 holder share above 45% as high risk.

instructions.name: Momentum confirmation
instructions.content: Prefer entries where volume rises with price over the last hour.

instructions.name: Young token caution
instructions.content: Require higher confidence for tokens younger than six hours.
